title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(森本喜隆研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Morimoto Yoshitaka)
keywords: Mechanical engineering 2.Vehicle system 3.Creation process 4.Energy and mechanics 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn technical mechanisms and new mechanisms required to research, develop, design, and manufacture socially useful and high-quality. (2) Obtain the ability to identify and solve problems in the related fields. (3) Learn about the importance of collaboration, particularly with local communities.
advice: This is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. To realize the educational objectives of the Department of Mechanical Engineering, this course focuses on the following goals: Students will acquire the ability to model phenomena accurately and analyze the models. Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to evaluate solutions using the obtained results. In practice, students should reconfirm their project theme, which was determined in Preparatory Seminar, with the supervisors of the individual laboratories. (The theme should be revised as necessary.) Students are expected to pursue the identification and solution of problems in accordance with the engineering process. Our laboratory develops and analyzes machine tools with new structures that enable the machining of target workpieces with nanometer accuracy, makes full use of structural analysis and positioning control technology on machine tools, and realizes high-speed and high-precision machining. For this reason, we would like to help students engaging in Design Project III to always try to absorb, understand, and apply knowledge. In addition, we will conduct research jointly with local machine tool manufacturers.
requiredKnowledge: Our laboratory aims to create new product shapes that are expected to be used in fields such as automobiles, IoT, and medical care by controlling precision positioning devices and machine tools. Your goal is to become a mechanical engineer who is familiar with measurement, control, and evaluation methods. Prior to the start of Design Project III, it is desirable to thoroughly review related courses, such as those of mathematics, machining, machining exercises, vibration analysis, and measurement engineering.

activityGoals.body: Be able to advance your project in accordance with the engineering design process.
Be able to compile the results correctly into an article and discuss the content through presentations.
Be able to act independently to solve the issues presented separately.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Understand the your project and the advancement process accurately, and achieve the established annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported in the Design Project Activity Support System. (2) Compile intermediate results for the project into the interim report, and present and discuss its content. Complete the final report, present it to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board, and discuss its content. (3) If necessary, design and manufacture your own experimental devices, and also evaluate the performance of the product.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the purpose of your project theme and the advancement process accurately, and achieve the established annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported in the Design Project Activity Support System. (2) Compile intermediate results for the project into the interim report, and present its content. Complete the final report and present it to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board. (3) Design and manufacture your own experimental devices as necessary. (The numbers in the text correspond to those of the student’s action goals.)

lessons.content: Reconfirm the project proposal that was submitted in Preparatory Seminar (revise it as necessary)
Submit the interim report and present it at the interim report meeting
Submit the final report and present it to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board
